protected_material: Do not access protected seeds 1704-1706, P4, or reserved material from other tracks.

phase1a.candidate_order: all four semantic foils, independently shuffled with correct answer fixed at specified position
phase1a.distractor: same identity in all four candidate scenes
phase1a.interpretation: Descriptive development analysis; historical confirmation models are no longer untouched for this new question. No outcome from this run independently confirms a new repair or predictor.

phase1b_existing_trajectories.scope: one historically selected graph and two seeds; developmental clue only
phase1b_existing_trajectories.early_stopping_caveat: Familiar validation was only saved at selected steps; any stopping-rule comparison here is illustrative and cannot establish a prospective rule.

post_result_rendering_check.reason: The all-pair map revealed weak pairs even in historical focal-pair confirmation models; check scene-sample stability.

phase1c_restricted_adapter_pilot.selection: five previously identified focal-pair-weak checkpoints in AUDIT_COMPONENT_RESULTS_20261006.md
phase1c_restricted_adapter_pilot.train_data: 1280 observed-pair configurations with fresh scenes; no withheld pair
phase1c_restricted_adapter_pilot.validation_data: 1280 observed-pair configurations with another scene seed
phase1c_restricted_adapter_pilot.optimizer: Adam, learning rate 0.01, 800 full-batch updates, weight deviation penalty 0.01
phase1c_restricted_adapter_pilot.checkpoint_selection: minimum familiar-validation cross entropy among 0,100,...,800 steps
phase1c_restricted_adapter_pilot.held_evaluation: the fixed 260107 all-pair suite; never used to choose the adapter step
phase1c_restricted_adapter_pilot.interpretation_limit: extra observed-pair training and no matched full-model continuation; a gain is diagnostic, not yet a controlled repair

phase1c_role_decoders.cases: five historically focal-weak checkpoints and their five matched other-condition controls
phase1c_role_decoders.validation: 16 observed meanings held aside from probe fitting; no unseen-pair data for model selection
phase1c_role_decoders.test: 100 unobserved ordered-pair-event meanings and eight new scenes per meaning
phase1c_role_decoders.optimizer: Adam learning rate 0.01, full batch, maximum 1000 updates
phase1c_role_decoders.selection: minimum observed-meaning validation loss among steps 100,200,...,1000
phase1c_role_decoders.readout: source identity, target identity, event; report exact two-role recovery
phase1c_role_decoders.interpretation_limit: supervised accessibility test, not evidence that the native decision uses the decoded labels
